Chapter 564: Chapter 13: The Ninth Shuttle! World of Gods (Subscribe Please)

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan likewise closed his eyes.

His mind sank deep into his mind, before the grand and magnificent Door to the Myriad Realms.

At this moment, the Door to the Myriad Realms radiated light, and the last world mark at the ‘threshold’ below was also glowing.

“During this traversal, keep an eye on the situation in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm at all times. Should Xilan be unable to withstand, directly annihilate the Taiyang Divine Spirit,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

...

Although Xilan had told him she could hold on for three years, Lin Yuan naturally would not place all his hopes on her.

After all, the opponent was Hunyi, the most powerful Ninth Rank life of the Tianyu Clan. Who knew what hidden cards had yet to be played?

Lin Yuan would never let his Taiyang Divine Spirit fall into the hands of the enemy, even if that Taiyang Divine Spirit was merely an empty shell, its most core Spirit Will had long ago escaped into the Door to the Myriad Realms, arriving in other dimensions.

As for how to annihilate the Taiyang Divine Spirit? Lin Yuan had long set up measures around the Taiyang Divine Spirit. Once triggered, the Taiyang Divine Spirit would rapidly collapse.

Of course, this meant that there was a high probability he would not unravel the secret of that ‘calling sensation’ during this period the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was open.

However, for Lin Yuan, it was not an unbearable loss.

Even if he did not obtain the opportunities within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan could still reach the peak of the universe, it would just take a bit longer.

“This traversal will last about eleven hundred years, with a time flow rate of over three hundred to one. More than two years will pass in the Main World…”

“In the traversed world’s eleven hundred years, I must at least cultivate to the Myriad Heavy Realm, creating a myriad of Spatial Layers…”

Lin Yuan set a plan for himself.

With his Inner World of nearly two hundred million square li, even opening up just a myriad of Spatial Layers could still crush someone like Hunyi, who had opened over thirty million Spatial Layers, despite being a special Ninth Rank.

This was the heritage from the Inner World itself.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan watched as the Door to the Myriad Realms in front of him grew more and more brilliant, with time and space slightly fluctuating, his entire consciousness was absorbed.

…

Lin Yuan only felt his consciousness blur, his thoughts tottering, and with great effort, he opened his eyes, only to feel an overwhelming weakness throughout his body.

“What is happening to me?”

Lin Yuan sat up, unable to take deep breaths.

This body was extremely weak, practically rotten at its core.

“Many Spatial Layers’ fluctuations…”

Lin Yuan looked around the void,

At his level, even if completely powerless,

his Realm would not fall, and he could easily observe the subtle shifts between spaces.

Of course, that was only seeing. To activate or use them, one had to have a sufficiently strong physical and spiritual form.

No matter what world, the physical and spiritual form is the foundation.

“I am the grandson of Viscount Longshan? The third successor of the Longshan Family? My favorite activity is to dote on the maids? The maids here are not limited to human women?”

Lin Yuan quickly absorbed the memories; no wonder this body was so weak.

Indulging in debauchery, leaking his Origin Source, if it weren’t for frequently consuming tonics, he probably would have ‘died from depletion’ by now.

“The world I have descended into…”

Lin Yuan’s expression became a bit solemn.

Though the original body was ignorant and incompetent, he still knew some common knowledge about the world.

This world was boundless, apart from the ‘human realm’ where Lin Yuan was, there were also parts like the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss.

Whether it was the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss, those were the dwellings of divine beings, said to each house the twelve strongest Prime Gods.

Twenty-four Prime Gods, high above, overlooking humankind and all deities.

“Divine beings…”

Information about divine beings surfaced in Lin Yuan’s mind.

To become a divine being, one must spread faith and then raise a Divine Kingdom, entering either the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss.

“Divine beings need to raise Divine Kingdoms… nearly equivalent to the Eighth Layer opening an Inner World?” Lin Yuan speculated in his mind.

So far, he did not know the actual strength of the deities of this realm, only being able to associate the Divine Kingdom with the Eighth Layer of the Main World.

“The powerful ones in this world, do they follow the path of spreading faith?”

Lin Yuan pondered thoughtfully. Faith is essentially the purest emotions and desires at the core of living beings.

The scholars of Human Civilization in the Main Universe had discovered this power long ago and even created some Evolutionary Paths utilizing this type of power.

Unfortunately, relying purely on the faith of living beings as a source of one’s power poses great risks, ultimately even leading to Evolvers losing themselves in the desires of beings.

Success by faith.

Defeat by faith.

However, in this world, the path of faith seems quite promising.

At least many divine beings, leveraging the faith of beings, raised Divine Kingdoms and ascended to divine thrones.

The twenty-four Prime Gods of the Ocean of Light and Dark Abyss even wield rule through the power of faith?

“Faith…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts drifted.

Spreading faith is not the same concept as spreading one’s own Evolutionary Path.

Faith is intense devotion, an unreserved adoration, but spreading an Evolutionary Path is different.

Like Lin Yuan’s Martial Path Evolutionary Path, future cultivators practicing it need not know of Lin Yuan.

“The Longshan Family, granted the imperial Viscount title, the founding Viscount Longshan indeed was a great contributor to the empire.”

“The territory of the Longshan Family, named Longshan Domain, spans about sixty million li… It seems this world is bigger than I anticipated…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was thoughtful.

Just the territory of a Viscount reaches sixty million li in area, so how large is the entire empire? And the empire where Longshan Ling is located is merely one country within the ‘Plateau of Myriad Nations’…
